name: Release IP Configuration
description: Releases the current IP configuration from your network adapter to help resolve connection issues or invalid addresses. This action requests a fresh network setup but does not increase internet speed.

description_i18n.en: Releases the current IP configuration from your network adapter to help resolve connection issues or invalid addresses. This action requests a fresh network setup but does not increase internet speed.
description_i18n.de: Gibt die aktuelle IP-Konfiguration des Netzwerkadapters frei, um Verbindungsprobleme oder ungültige Adressen zu beheben. Dies fordert eine neue Netzwerkkonfiguration an, erhöht aber nicht die Internetgeschwindigkeit.
description_i18n.fr: Libère la configuration IP actuelle de votre adaptateur réseau pour résoudre les problèmes de connexion ou d'adresses invalides. Cette action demande une nouvelle configuration sans augmenter la vitesse internet.

warnings.title: Temporary connectivity loss
warnings.message: Your internet connection may drop briefly while your device requests a new IP address from the router

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Executes the ipconfig /release command to discard the current IPv4 and IPv6 addresses assigned by DHCP or static settings on active network adapters
